purpose: Minimal secure boundary for future cloud-browser credentials and provider tests.

endpoints.purpose: Accept a credential once and store it server-side. Never echo it back.
Create a remote browser session and return non-secret session metadata/live-view URL.
Run READY -> ACTIVE -> VERIFY -> DONE using the existing Worker Lab packet.

rules: No secret in GitHub Pages, localStorage, query strings, screenshots, logs, or workflow artifacts.
Human interaction is only for identity, CAPTCHA/2FA, terms, or a sensitive final confirmation.
A provider is READY only after health + model discovery + message test + worker test.
A browser adapter is READY only after session create + navigation + evidence + optional human takeover test.
